subject: POC acceptance cadence & owner rostering
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Lina Park <lina@lucentai.com>, Tom Garcia <tom.garcia@lucentai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: POC acceptance cadence & owner rostering

Hi Lina / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and the next steps we discussed so we have a shared playbook to start the POC: 

1) Goal & success criteria (agreed):
- Validate accuracy on domain-specific retrieval + 90th percentile latency under 350ms for interactive queries.
- Achieve end-to-end throughput to support 50 concurrent agents during peak tests.
- Demonstrate determinism on a fixed prompt set (versioned prompts).

2) Scope & deliverables:
- Week 0: Kickoff + infra access (VPC peering + API key rotation).
- Weeks 1–3: Ingest & sync sample dataset (5M tokens), baseline evals, and initial tuning.
- Week 4: Load/soak test + final readout with metrics and recommended config.

3) Ownership (proposed):
- Redwood: Jonas (overall owner / contact), Marissa (evaluation lead — metrics & readout), Dylan (infra & integration).
- Lucent: Lina (product), Tom (platform / infra).

4) Schedule / weekly rituals:
- Weekly 30-min check-in on Wednesdays, 10:00am PT — sync on blockers + metric trends.
- Midpoint review at end of Week 2 with interim dashboard + short demo.
- Final readout: Friday of Week 4 (recorded, deck + raw results).

5) Access & artifacts we need from Lucent by EOD Mon (Jun 21):
- Service account for VPC peering (network contact + CIDRs).
- Sample dataset pointer and schema (S3 / GCS).
- List of 30 canonical prompts for acceptance tests.

Attachments: I’m including the POC-checklist-template.xlsx and SOW-draft-v1.pdf in case that speeds procurement.

Please reply with any timing conflicts or if you want to adjust the success gates — otherwise I’ll put the kickoff invite on your calendars for Mon Jun 28, 10:00am PT.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Lina Park <lina@lucentai.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Garcia <tom.garcia@lucentai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 16:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC acceptance cadence & owner rostering

Jonas —

Appreciate the clear recap. We’re aligned on the high level. A few quick clarifications from our side before kickoff: 

• Latency: is the 350ms gate measured from Redwood API ingress (post-routing) or inclusive of our network hop? We want consistent measurement definitions.
• Data: we can provide a 3M token sample by Monday; full 5M by the end of Week 1 if needed.
• Security: our security team will require an SCP + proof of SOC2 in addition to the SOW; can you surface our security contacts to your compliance team?

We are okay with Jun 28 kickoff but Tom is out that day — can we move the invite to Jun 29, 10:00am PT? If that’s a problem we’ll still send an attendee with sufficient platform access.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.
Lina
Lina Park
Head of Product, Lucent AI
lina@lucentai.com

Lina —

Great points — answers inline below and one small change to schedule:

• Latency measurement: Redwood will report latency measured at our API ingress (post-routing). We’ll also provide an optional client-side measurement script you can run to capture your network delta; that will be included in the Week 1 baselines.

• Data: 3M tokens Monday is fine — we’ll start with what you can provide and flag any data gaps during Week 1.

• Security / SOC2: copying Casey (compliance) on this thread so your security team has a single point of contact. Casey will share our SOC2 summary and the standard SCP template.

• Kickoff: Jun 29, 10:00am PT works for us — I’ll send the updated invite.

Action items (Jonas / Redwood):
- Send updated invite (Jonas) — by EOD today.
- Share client-side latency script + run instructions (Dylan) — by Mon Jun 21.
- Prep Week 2 interim dashboard template (Marissa) — by Jun 24.

Action items (Lucent):
- Provide service account details + dataset pointer (Lina/Tom) — by Jun 21.
- Security contact + SCP requirements (Tom) — as soon as possible.

Attachments: I’m reattaching the POC checklist and a short milestone calendar so we have something concrete for the kickoff.

Thanks —
Jonas

Marissa / Dylan —

Quick internal note after the Lucent thread:

- Kickoff moved to Jun 29, 10:00am PT. Calendar invite sent to external stakeholders; please accept when you see it.
- Marissa: you’ll own the Week 2 interim dashboard + readout deck. I’ve attached the checklist we shared. Keep the metrics focused on: accuracy on canonical prompts, 90th pct latency, throughput at target concurrency, and token cost per 1k requests.
- Dylan: please prepare the client-side latency script and a short runbook for their infra team (include expected ports for VPC peering and a sample troubleshooting checklist).
- I’ll confirm compliance intro (Casey) on Monday once I get Tom’s security contact.

If either of you sees a risk to the schedule based on the artifact deadlines listed in the invite, flag it here.

Thanks —
Jonas
